metadata.question: Did the water extent of Lake Sambhar, India, decrease between 2018 and 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use Sentinel-2 Surface Reflectance (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED), Jan 1–Dec 31 for 2018 and 2019, over a polygon enclosing Lake Sambhar, Rajasthan, India (approx 74.95E–75.35E, 26.80N–27.15N).
2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds and cirrus using QA60 bits 10 and 11. Compute NDWI per image, then annual median NDWI. Water mask: NDWI > 0.2.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection sizes. If zero, widen date window to 2 years. If still zero, return C1.
- Count valid pixels after masking; if zero, C2.
- If any reduceRegion returns null/NaN, C3.
- If areas valid, compare 2019 area versus 2018 area (≥1% decrease => A; else B).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const lakeGeom = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
      [[[74.95, 26.80], [75.35, 26.80], [75.35, 27.15], [74.95, 27.15], [74.95, 26.80]]],
      null, false
    );
    const years = [2018, 2019];
    const scale = 1000;
    const maxPixels = 1e9;

    // 2. Helpers
    function maskS2sr(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA60');
      const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10;
      const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11;
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }
    function addNDWI(img) {
      const ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('ndwi');
      return img.addBands(ndwi);
    }
    function analyzeYear(year) {
      const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 1);
      const end = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 12, 31);
      let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(lakeGeom)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .map(maskS2sr)
        .map(addNDWI)
        .select('ndwi');
      const sizePrimary = col.size();
      // Fallback: widen date if empty
      const widenedStart = ee.Date.fromYMD(year - 1, 7, 1);
      const widenedEnd = ee.Date.fromYMD(year + 1, 6, 30);
      const colWidened = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(lakeGeom)
        .filterDate(widenedStart, widenedEnd)
        .map(maskS2sr)
        .map(addNDWI)
        .select('ndwi');
      const sizePrimaryInfo = sizePrimary.getInfo();
      let usedCollection = col;
      let usedSize = sizePrimaryInfo;
      let widenedUsed = false;
      if (sizePrimaryInfo === 0) {
        const widenedSize = colWidened.size().getInfo();
        if (widenedSize === 0) {
          return {
            year: year,
            status: 'C1',
            msg: year + ' Images: 0'
          };
        } else {
          usedCollection = colWidened;
          usedSize = widenedSize;
          widenedUsed = true;
        }
      }
      const ndwiMed = usedCollection.median().select('ndwi');
      // Counts
      const validCount = ndwiMed.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: lakeGeom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('ndwi');
      const totalCount = ee.Image(1).rename('const').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: lakeGeom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('const');
      const waterMask = ndwiMed.gt(0.2).rename('water');
      const waterArea = waterMask.updateMask(waterMask).multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea())
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: lakeGeom,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: maxPixels
        }).get('water');
      // Bring to client
      const validCountInfo = validCount.getInfo();
      const totalCountInfo = totalCount.getInfo();
      const waterAreaM2 = waterArea.getInfo();

      if (validCountInfo === null || totalCountInfo === null || waterAreaM2 === null) {
        return { year: year, status: 'C3', msg: 'Calculation failure' };
      }
      if (!isFinite(validCountInfo) || !isFinite(totalCountInfo) || !isFinite(waterAreaM2)) {
        return { year: year, status: 'C3', msg: 'Invalid number' };
      }
      if (validCountInfo === 0) {
        return { year: year, status: 'C2', msg: 'No valid pixels after masking' };
      }
      const cloudPct = (1 - (validCountInfo / totalCountInfo)) * 100;
      return {
        year: year,
        status: 'OK',
        images: usedSize,
        widened: widenedUsed,
        validPix: validCountInfo,
        totalPix: totalCountInfo,
        cloudPct: cloudPct,
        waterKm2: waterAreaM2 / 1e6
      };
    }

    // 3. Process years
    const res2018 = analyzeYear(2018);
    if (res2018.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(`2018 Images: ${res2018.msg || res2018.status}`);
      if (res2018.status === 'C1') { console.log('C1: Empty Collection'); return; }
      if (res2018.status === 'C2') { console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels'); return; }
      if (res2018.status === 'C3') { console.log('C3: Calculation Failure'); return; }
      console.log('D'); return;
    }
    const res2019 = analyzeYear(2019);
    if (res2019.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(`2019 Images: ${res2019.msg || res2019.status}`);
      if (res2019.status === 'C1') { console.log('C1: Empty Collection'); return; }
      if (res2019.status === 'C2') { console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels'); return; }
      if (res2019.status === 'C3') { console.log('C3: Calculation Failure'); return; }
      console.log('D'); return;
    }

    // 4. Output concise evidence
    const line2018 = `2018 S2 Images: ${res2018.images}` + (res2018.widened ? ' (widened)' : '') +
      `, ValidPix@1km: ${res2018.validPix}, Cloud/Invalid: ${res2018.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%, Water_km2: ${res2018.waterKm2.toFixed(2)}`;
    const line2019 = `2019 S2 Images: ${res2019.images}` + (res2019.widened ? ' (widened)' : '') +
      `, ValidPix@1km: ${res2019.validPix}, Cloud/Invalid: ${res2019.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%, Water_km2: ${res2019.waterKm2.toFixed(2)}`;
    console.log(line2018);
    console.log(line2019);

    // 5. Decision
    const change = res2019.waterKm2 - res2018.waterKm2;
    const changePct = (change / (res2018.waterKm2 === 0 ? 1 : res2018.waterKm2)) * 100;
    console.log(`Change_km2: ${change.toFixed(2)} (${changePct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    if (!isFinite(change) || !isFinite(changePct)) {
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }
    const decreased = changePct < -1.0; // require >1% decrease to say Yes
    console.log(decreased ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
